capabilities: Find files by path, name, or alias via fuzzy matching
Search note contents full-text and preview the matching Markdown block
Build queries with atoms and modifiers (substring, prefix, postfix, exact, negation)
Find and run Obsidian commands from a palette view
Navigate and open results with keyboard or mouse shortcuts
intentEvidence: A fast fuzzy finder and quick switcher with previews.
problem: Obsidian's built-in quick switcher and search lack preview panes and fine-grained query modifiers, and heavy searches can affect editor responsiveness.
summary: Fuzzy finder that adds dedicated search views for files, aliases, commands, and full-text note content, each with a live preview.
